businessName.title: Business name
businessName.description: The business name to find in Google Maps local results (e.g. 'Acme Dental'). Use the name shown on the Business Profile. This is a matching hint, not a Google Business Profile ID.

providerMode.title: DataForSEO provider mode
providerMode.description: Cost-optimized Standard priority is the default and typically costs about $0.0006 per SERP task; choose Live only when a realtime result is worth about $0.002. The Actor rejects provider responses above $0.006 per check so the $0.06 event retains at least a 70% contribution-margin floor after Apify's 80% share.

targetDomain.title: Business website domain
targetDomain.description: Optional website domain used as a stronger match signal (e.g. 'acmedental.com'). Enter a domain only, without https:// or a path. This does not crawl the website or verify ownership.

placeId.title: Google place ID
placeId.description: Optional stable Google place identifier for exact matching when the provider returns it. Example: 'ChIJ...'. This is not an Apify Actor ID and cannot be discovered by this run.

cid.title: Google CID
cid.description: Optional Google client ID for a local establishment. Example: '1234567890123456789'. Use this when your business already has a known CID; it is stronger than name-only matching.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to check, such as ['dentist near me', 'emergency dentist']. Each keyword is tested at every location. Provide 1–20 terms; this Actor does not generate keyword ideas.

locations.title: Search locations
locations.description: Geographic points where each keyword is checked. Each object must set exactly one of locationCode, locationName, or locationCoordinate. Coordinates make a geo-grid possible; use 'latitude,longitude' or 'latitude,longitude,radius'. Maximum 25 locations.

label.title: Grid point label
label.description: Human-readable label for this point, such as 'Downtown' or 'Northwest'.

locationCode.title: DataForSEO location code
locationCode.description: DataForSEO Google location code, such as 2840 for the United States. Use instead of locationName or locationCoordinate.

locationName.title: DataForSEO location name
locationName.description: Full DataForSEO location name, such as 'New York,New York,United States'. Use instead of locationCode or locationCoordinate.

locationCoordinate.title: GPS coordinate
locationCoordinate.description: Coordinate snapshot in 'latitude,longitude' or 'latitude,longitude,radius' format, such as '40.7128,-74.0060,500'. Use instead of locationCode or locationName.

languageCode.title: Search language
languageCode.description: the keyword-data API Google language code for the snapshot, such as 'en' or 'es'. Defaults to 'en'. This controls result language and is not a country selector.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device profile used for the Google snapshot. 'desktop' returns up to the requested depth; 'mobile' follows Google's mobile result layout. Defaults to desktop.

depth.title: Maps result depth
depth.description: How many Google Maps businesses the keyword-data API should inspect per check (e.g. 100). Defaults to 100; higher depth can increase provider charges, while this Actor's Apify event remains one check row. This is Maps result depth, not an organic SERP depth.

competitorNames.title: Competitor names
competitorNames.description: Optional business names to locate in the same returned Google Maps rows. Example: ['Rival Dental']. Name matching is exact after normalization; competitor rows are not separate checks or separate charges.
